clusters.story: Zelenskyy Meets US Envoys as Witkoff Travels to Putin in St. Petersburg
clusters.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff and European leaders in Oslo to restore early-warning missile intelligence following talks with Secretary of State Marco Rubio, even as a Russian missile and drone blitz killed nine across Ukraine. Witkoff then departed immediately for St. Petersburg to hold direct negotiations with Russian President Vladimir Putin, while Russia independently freed 74-year-old retired American schoolteacher Stephen Hubbard from prison after more than four years behind bars.

clusters.story: French Unrest and Protests Shut Paris Museums
clusters.summary: Following severe nationwide riots, looting, and widespread arrests over living costs, French authorities implemented localized nighttime curfews across major cities including Paris and Nice. Protesters subsequently blocked entrances to the Louvre Museum and staged copycat demonstrations in Milan and Brussels, prompting Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez to offer his resignation as authorities deployed 70,000 police officers.

coverage.title: After French Riots, Curfews & Calm .. is a new Storm Brewing ? Plus Ukraine & Israel
coverage.description: It's been a week that’s seen mass protests hijacked by violent rioters across France. clusters.story: Trump Asked Musk to Lift Ukraine Starlink Restrictions
clusters.summary: Ukrainian military operations faced severe setbacks after SpaceX restricted Starlink and Starshield satellite connectivity—which investigations revealed Elon Musk personally ordered—prompting urgent talks between President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio. clusters.story: Tibet Autonomous Region Hit by Magnitude-7.0 Earthquake

clusters.story: West Bank Settler Attacks on Olive Harvest and Diplomats
clusters.summary: Masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian olive harvesters, European diplomats, a visiting French mayor, and U.S. photojournalist Heidi Levine in Taybeh during the annual West Bank olive harvest, prompting rare Israeli police raids that detained 10 suspects before courts released them to house arrest. clusters.story: China Q3 Economic Growth
clusters.summary: China reported a stronger-than-expected 4.5 percent economic growth rate for the third quarter of 2026, accelerating slightly from the previous quarter's 4.3 percent. clusters.story: France Detects First Human Case of Shamonda Virus
clusters.summary: French health authorities documented the country's first human infection and fatality linked to the Shamonda virus in an immunocompromised patient who died in early October.
